name: Firebase Firestore
description: NoSQL cloud database with real-time sync, offline support, and automatic scaling via Google Firebase.
postInstallNotes:
1. Download a service account key from Firebase Console → Project Settings → Service accounts.
2. Paste the `private_key` value (including `-----BEGIN...`) into `FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY`.
3. Use `db.collection('users').doc(uid).get()` for reads, `.set()` / `.update()` for writes.
